resources.string: Monitoring settings

These optional values describe a local monitoring plan. They do not activate instrumentation, resolve credentials, establish telemetry coverage or prove readiness. Supply each value explicitly; omission is not zero, unknown or not applicable.
Sample rate (fraction)
Retention (days)
Credential reference
Optional exact number from 0 through 1, inclusive. Enter a fraction, not a percentage. Use a dot for a decimal value.
Optional whole number of days, at least 0. A supplied zero remains a declared value; it does not prove that data is deleted.
Optional opaque secret:// reference. Never paste the credential itself. This editor neither opens nor resolves the reference.

Only bounded input and its original draft, revision and selection identity can be recovered. Unrecognized credential input is excluded from recovery. A pending save or changed source is read-only; recovery never replays a write.
Not supplied
Supplied empty input
Supplied input
Supply %1$s
Enter a value or clear Supply to omit this setting.
Enter one JSON number using a dot for decimals; text, comma decimals and extra values are not accepted.
Enter one whole JSON number of days; fractions, comma decimals and extra values are not accepted.
Sample rate must be between 0 and 1, inclusive.
Retention days must be at least 0.
Enter an opaque secret:// reference using only letters, digits, /, _, :, . or - after the prefix. Never paste a credential value.
This input exceeds the local editor limit. Shorten it or clear Supply.
